## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting passes (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Types pass (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Builds pass (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Package validation passes (`npm run check:package`)
- [ ] Browser tests pass when UI behavior changed (`npm run test:e2e`)

## Review checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog for user-facing changes.
- [ ] I considered keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, and reduced-motion behavior.
- [ ] I considered React 18/19 and Next.js compatibility.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute every code, text, and image asset in this change.
- [ ] I removed private EXIF data, GPS coordinates, serial numbers, emails, credentials, and client images.
